statements.query: MATCH (bucket:S3Bucket)<-[:RESOURCE]-(aws:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE bucket.anonymous_access IS NOT NULL OR bucket.anonymous_access_type IS NOT NULL OR bucket.anonymous_actions IS NOT NULL OR bucket.publicContext IS NOT NULL WITH bucket LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE bucket.anonymous_access_type,bucket.anonymous_actions,bucket.anonymous_access,bucket.publicContext return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (bucket:S3Bucket{is_public: true})<-[:RESOURCE]-(aws:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE NOT coalesce(bucket.restrict_public_buckets, false) AND NOT coalesce(aws.s3_restrict_public_buckets, false) SET bucket.anonymous_access = true,(CASE WHEN NOT 'policy' IN  coalesce(bucket.anonymous_access_type , []) THEN bucket END).anonymous_access_type = coalesce(bucket.anonymous_access_type , []) + 'policy';

MATCH (acl:S3Acl)-[:APPLIES_TO]->(bucket:S3Bucket)<-[:RESOURCE]-(aws:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})
WHERE acl.uri IN ['http://acs.amazonaws.com/groups/global/AllUsers', 'http://acs.amazonaws.com/groups/global/AuthenticatedUsers'] AND acl.permission = 'WRITE' AND NOT coalesce(bucket.ignore_public_acls, false) AND NOT coalesce(aws.s3_ignore_public_acls, false)
AND (acl.ownerid = acl.granteeid)
SET bucket.anonymous_access = true, bucket.anonymous_actions = coalesce(bucket.anonymous_actions, []) + ['s3:DeleteObjectVersion'],(CASE WHEN NOT 'acl' IN  coalesce(bucket.anonymous_access_type , []) THEN bucket END).anonymous_access_type = coalesce(bucket.anonymous_access_type , []) + 'acl';

MATCH (bucket:S3Bucket)<-[:RESOURCE]-(aws:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE bucket.anonymous_access = true WITH bucket OPTIONAL MATCH (acl:S3Acl)-[:APPLIES_TO]->(bucket) WHERE acl.uri IN ['http://acs.amazonaws.com/groups/global/AllUsers', 'http://acs.amazonaws.com/groups/global/AuthenticatedUsers'] WITH bucket, collect(DISTINCT {grantee: acl.uri, permission: acl.permission}) as aclGrants SET bucket.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: bucket.name, resourceType: 'aws-storage-s3-bucket', context: [{bucketName: bucket.name, bucketArn: bucket.arn, region: bucket.region, isPublic: bucket.is_public, anonymousActions: coalesce(bucket.anonymous_actions, []), anonymousAccessType: bucket.anonymous_access_type, aclGrants: aclGrants, blockPublicAcls: coalesce(bucket.block_public_acls, true), blockPublicPolicy: coalesce(bucket.block_public_policy, true), ignorePublicAcls: coalesce(bucket.ignore_public_acls, true), restrictPublicBuckets: coalesce(bucket.restrict_public_buckets, true)}]}])
